map.计算醛固酮/肾素比值(ARR)，筛查原发性醛固酮增多症(原醛症)，指导确诊试验: Compute the aldosterone/renin ratio (ARR) to screen for primary aldosteronism and guide the confirmatory test
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：min(100, (arr ÷ barMax) ×: Core formulas (by input): min(100, (arr ÷ barMax) × 100); aldo ÷ (renin × 1)
map.📖 查看「醛固酮/肾素(ARR)比值计算器 使用指南」: 📖 See the "Aldosterone/Renin (ARR) Ratio Calculator User Guide"
map.需结合醛固酮绝对值，必要时复查: Combine with the absolute aldosterone value and repeat if needed
map.建议行确诊试验(生理盐水输注试验等): A confirmatory test is advised (such as saline infusion)
map.高度怀疑原醛症，需确诊分型: Strongly suspect primary aldosteronism, confirmatory testing and subtyping needed
map.注：若使用直接肾素浓度(DRC)，阈值 = 醛固酮(ng/dL) ÷ DRC(m: Note: when direct renin concentration (DRC) is used, the threshold = aldosterone (ng/dL) ÷ DRC (mU/L), with a positive threshold around 3.7-5.7.
map.• 顽固性高血压（≥3种降压药未控）: • Resistant hypertension (uncontrolled on 3 or more drugs)
map.• 早发高血压或脑卒中家族史（<40岁）: • Early-onset hypertension or a family history of stroke (under 40)
map.停用影响ARR的药物至少2-4周。螺内酯、阿米洛利、利尿剂需停用6周；β受体阻滞: Stop drugs that affect ARR for at least 2-4 weeks. Spironolactone, amiloride and diuretics need 6 weeks; beta-blockers falsely raise ARR (they suppress renin) while ACEI/ARB falsely lower it (they raise renin). Verapamil sustained-release plus an alpha-blocker can be used as a bridge. Correct hypokalaemia first.
map.难治性高血压伴低血钾的原发性醛固酮增多症筛查。: Screening for primary aldosteronism in resistant hypertension with hypokalaemia.
map.肾上腺意外瘤合并高血压的功能评估。: Functional assessment of an adrenal incidentaloma with hypertension.
map.年轻高血压或早发脑血管事件家族史者的病因筛查。: Cause screening in young hypertension or with a family history of early cerebrovascular events.
map.血浆醛固酮 200 pg/mL、肾素 1.0 ng/mL/h：ARR=200（常: Plasma aldosterone 200 pg/mL and renin 1.0 ng/mL/h give ARR=200 (common cut-offs are over 30-50, depending on units and reagent). A raised ratio suggests primary aldosteronism; stop interfering drugs and confirm with a saline loading or captopril test.
map.ACEI/ARB、利尿剂、β 受体阻滞剂、NSAIDs 与甘草制剂可显著改变醛固: ACEI/ARB, diuretics, beta-blockers, NSAIDs and licorice preparations can markedly change aldosterone/renin, and screening usually requires stopping them for 2-4 weeks as advised by your doctor.
map.ARR 阳性就一定是原醛吗？: Does a positive ARR mean it is definitely primary aldosteronism?
map.ARR 是筛查而非确诊。需结合确诊试验（盐水/卡托普利/口服钠负荷）与影像，部分: ARR is a screening test, not a diagnosis. It needs a confirmatory test (saline, captopril or oral sodium loading) plus imaging; older people and renovascular hypertension can also give false positives.
map.ARR(醛固酮/肾素比值)是原发性醛固酮增多症首选筛查指标，本工具计算比值并给出: ARR (aldosterone to renin ratio) is the first-line screening index for primary aldosteronism; this tool computes the ratio and gives screening threshold interpretation and confirmation advice.
map.支持PRA和DRC两种单位: Supports both PRA and DRC units
